title: The Awareness Logic of Ambiguity (ALA): Triadic Interpretive States and Their Structure-Preserving Operational Core
summary: The Awareness Logic of Ambiguity (ALA) is introduced as a formal framework for preserving the structure of judgment before scalar projection. An evaluative act is represented by a triadic interpretive state with three functionally distinct roles: interpretive valuation, contextual alignment, and epistemic restraint. ALA uses a cognitive order with reversed polarity for restraint and shows that the resulting state space forms a bounded distributive lattice.
